Survivors of the 2016 Eseka rail disaster are still awaiting justice a decade after the crash, and a French court has authorized a third-party funder to enforce an ICC award against the state. The Supreme Court halted the appeal of a former minister sentenced for embezzlement, and a Cameroonian scholar has called for new peace talks with Anglophone separatists. The conflict caused 231 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
approved.nb: Cameroons BIR-hurtigintervensjonsstyrke har utvidet sin tilstedeværelse rundt Tsjad-sjøen mens droner og felles grensepatruljer fortsetter å målrette anglofonse separatister i Nordvest og Sørvest, hvor angrep på regjeringsstyrker vedvarer. Overlevende fra Eseka-jernbaneulykken i 2016 venter fortsatt på rettferdighet et tiår etter krasjen, og en fransk domstol har gitt en tredjepartsfinansiør tillatelse til å håndheve en ICC-dom mot staten. Høyesterett stoppet anken til en tidligere minister som ble dømt for underslag, og en kamerunske forsker har oppfordret til nye fredssamtaler med de anglofonse separatistene. Konflikten forårsaket 231 dødsfall i kamp i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

Chad arrested four suspects after an attack in Miski, and CAR officials denied that their forces crossed the Chad border during a raid. Three former hostages were released and greeted by President Touadéra on their return to Bangui. The conflict caused 246 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

approved.en: Libyan armed forces have executed 31 people after unfair military trials, breaking a 15‑year moratorium, while rights groups report eastern authorities carrying out executions and 50 detainees face imminent execution. Heavy rainfall in Tripoli caused at least three deaths in one incident and two deaths in separate incidents, adding to flood-related casualties. The European Union has expanded migration cooperation with eastern Libya, and China has called for an end to Libya’s political deadlock. A football match between Morocco and Libya will be broadcast on beIN SPORTS as part of the 2026 Futsal AFCON. There were two battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Kraftig nedbør i Tripoli forårsaket minst tre dødsfall i én hendelse og to dødsfall i separate hendelser, noe som øker antallet dødsfall knyttet til flom. The conversation was accompanied by books and letters from King Charles III, which Myanmar authorities noted. Military commander Min Aung Hlaing met Japan envoy Sasakawa, showing diplomatic engagement despite ongoing fighting. At least two people were killed in a blast in the Rakhine state capital. The conflict still caused 2,332 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

Samtalen ble ledsaget av bøker og brev fra kong Charles III, som myndighetene i Myanmar bemerket. Militærkommandør Min Aung Hlaing møtte Japans representant Sasakawa, noe som viser diplomatisk kontakt til tross for pågående kamper. Minst to personer ble drept i en eksplosjon i hovedstaden i Rakhine. Konflikten forårsaket fortsatt 2 332 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Security forces in Manipur seized a Kuki-Zo camp, took over the Sinai camp, arrested 17 suspects for impersonating SoO cadres and confiscated a large arms cache, while protests erupted over the killing of three Meitei men and police seized 24 firearms. In Kashmir, the IGP called for action against overground workers and hybrid terrorists, reviewed crime disposal and winter preparedness, and warned that police nakas must become more intelligence driven. The BJP rebuked Farooq Abdullah over his statements on PoK, and the VHP joined the attack on his remarks, while the Manipur chief minister proposed a state-wide committee after a query from the prime minister. 437 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.

I Kashmir oppfordret IGP til tiltak mot overgrunnsarbeidere og hybride terrorister, gjennomgikk kriminalitetsbehandling og vinterberedskap, og advarte om at politiets nakas må bli mer etterretningsdrevet. BJP kritiserte Farooq Abdullah for hans uttalelser om PoK, og VHP sluttet seg til angrepet på hans bemerkninger, mens Manipur-statsministeren foreslo en statlig komité etter en henvendelse fra statsministeren. 437 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

approved.en: Chinese militia boats are expanding battlefield preparation in the western Pacific while the Chinese coast guard monitors Philippine resupply missions to the grounded BRP Sierra Madre at Ayungin Shoal. The Philippine Coast Guard rescued 20 people off Basilan and opened an upgraded station on Pag-asa Island, but two Coast Guard personnel were killed in a shooting in Cotabato City. Taiwan is offering cooperation to protect undersea cables, and an ex-NSA urged activation of the Philippines-China coast guard agreement. The DND chief warned that any Chinese attempt to tow the BRP Sierra Madre would be an act of war. 176 battle-related deaths occurred in 2024, according to UCDP.

Filippinernes kystvakt reddet 20 personer utenfor Basilan og åpnet en oppgradert stasjon på Pag-asa-øya, men to kystvaktsoldater ble drept i en skyting i Cotabato City. Taiwan tilbyr samarbeid for å beskytte undersjøiske kabler, og en tidligere NSA oppfordret til aktivering av avtalen mellom Filippinene og Kina om kystvakten. DND-sjefen advarte om at ethvert kinesisk forsøk på å tau til BRP Sierra Madre ville være en krigshandling. 176 kamprelaterte dødsfall fant sted i 2024, ifølge UCDP.
